episodes.200100: On the evening of April 11th, 2025, lightning struck a group of people fishing near Jacksonville, NC. One died as a result of the lightning strike.
episodes.200176: Surface low pressure over the Coastal Plain gradually tracked northeastwards through the afternoon and evening, eventually pushing off the coast of the Northern Outer Banks during the evening hours of April eleventh. As this occurred, associated upper level low and surface trough swept eastwards across the Coastal Plain and offshore behind this departing low pressure system during the evening hours on the eleventh as well. This upper low brought widely scattered showers and thunderstorms with its passage with a few of these storms becoming strong in nature. These storms mainly impacted the waters around the Crystal Coast bringing a damaging wind and hail threat to the area.
episodes.200574: A thunderstorm moving offshore produced strong wind gusts along and offshore from the Volusia County coastline.
episodes.201041: Surface low pressure over the Coastal Plain gradually tracked northeastwards through the evening. The low brought a few showers and thunderstorms with its passage with one particular storm becoming severe and producing large hail in the evening.
episodes.202374: Thunderstorms associated with a cold front moving across the Florida peninsula produce gusty marine winds over Tampa and Sarasota Bay waters.
